sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Stance-dependent like Stalact: it absorbs whichever element it is currently in. Check the stance before spending a turn.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances

Bring Fire in Ice Stance, Ice in Fire Stance damage. Fire in Fire Stance, Ice in Ice Stance is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Danseuse
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire in Ice Stance, Ice in Fire Stance is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Fire in Fire Stance, Ice in Ice Stance, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
